review_candidates.title: Quality & Learning Coordinator
review_candidates.description: our day-to-day Coordinate and monitor the hotel's quality standards, employee grooming, learning and development, and recruitment activities to ensure employees are equipped to deliver consistent service excellence in line with Holiday Inn, IHG and Valor Hospitality standards. Work closely with Heads of Department to develop employees, improve performance, support recruitment and promote a culture of continuous improvement. Conduct regular quality checks across hotel departments to monitor compliance with applicable service standards and procedures. Observe service delivery and identify opportunities to improve guest satisfaction and the overall guest experience. Work closely with HODs to address service gaps, grooming issues and non-compliance with established standards. Follow up on corrective actions and monitor the implementation of agreed improvements. Review guest feedback and complaints to identify recurring service issues and potential training needs. Maintain records of quality inspections, observations and corrective actions. Promote professionalism, accountability and continuous improvement throughout the hotel. Learning & Development Coordinate the hotel's annual training plan and training calendar in consultation with the People & Culture Lead and HODs. Identify training needs and skills gaps across departments. Coordinate induction and onboarding programmes for new employees. Organise and facilitate training sessions on guest service, communication, complaint handling, teamwork and professional standards. Coordinate applicable mandatory training, including health and safety, fire safety, first aid and food safety, using appropriately qualified trainers where required. Coordinate relevant IHG and Valor Hospitality learning programmes and monitor completion requirements. Work with HODs and supervisors to support on-the-job training, coaching and cross-training. Maintain accurate training records, attendance registers, certificates and completion reports. Evaluate training effectiveness and recommend refresher training where necessary. Identify employee development opportunities and support internal career progression. Recruitment & Talent Acquisition Coordinate recruitment activities in collaboration with the People & Culture Lead and relevant HODs. Identify recruitment needs and maintain an updated vacancy tracker. Prepare and publish job advertisements through appropriate recruitment channels. Screen CVs and shortlist candidates according to approved job requirements. Conduct initial interviews and coordinate further interviews with the relevant HODs. Liaise with recruitment agencies, hospitality schools and educational institutions. Coordinate internship and trainee recruitment programmes. Maintain accurate and confidential candidate records. Coordinate recruitment documentation, employment offers and joining arrangements with the People & Culture team. Support the onboarding process to ensure a smooth integration of new employees. Monitor recruitment progress and provide regular updates on vacancies and recruitment activities. Employee Development & Engagement Work closely with HODs to identify employees' development needs and potential for career progression. Coordinate individual development plans and support employee coaching initiatives. Follow up on probation reviews and communicate identified development needs to the relevant HODs. Support performance improvement initiatives in collaboration with the People & Culture Lead and HODs. Assist with employee engagement, recognition, welfare and retention initiatives. Promote the hotel's values, service culture, teamwork and professional behaviour. Support initiatives that encourage internal mobility and the development of future supervisors and managers. General People & Culture Support Assist the People & Culture Lead with HR projects, audits, reporting and policy implementation. Support employee induction, internal communication and hotel-wide engagement activities. Assist with the preparation of HR presentations, reports and relevant documentation. Collaborate with the People & Culture Assistant to ensure effective coordination of recruitment, onboarding and training administration. Provide operational support to the People & Culture department when required, while maintaining focus on the core responsibilities of quality, learning and recruitment. Maintain confidentiality when handling employee, candidate and hotel information. Perform other duties and assignments as directed by the People & Culture Lead from time to time. QUALIFICATIONS, EXPERIENCE & COMPETENCIESEducation & Qualifications Diploma or degree in Human Resources Management, Hospitality Management, Learning & Development, Quality Management or a related field. Relevant professional qualifications or certifications in training, recruitment, quality assurance or hospitality will be an advantage. Experience Minimum of 2–3 years of relevant experience in the hospitality industry, preferably within a hotel or resort environment. Previous experience in training coordination, quality assurance, guest experience, recruitment or employee development. Experience conducting training sessions, monitoring service standards and working closely with departmental managers. Familiarity with international hotel brand standards and quality assurance processes will be an advantage.
